definitions.gloss: short sentence; short passage; brief text
definitions.explanation: A sentence or passage that is short in length. Often used in language learning, exams, and writing exercises to describe brief pieces of text.

examples.japanese: {短文|たんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{短文|たんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{英語|えいご}→英語：02274_eigo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{訳|やく}す→訳す：02319_yakusu⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: On the exam, there were questions where you had to translate short sentences into English.

examples.japanese: ⟦メッセージ→メッセージ：03828_messeeji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{短文|たんぶん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{簡潔|かんけつ}→簡潔：05621_kanketsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わり→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧やすい。
examples.english: Messages are easier to understand when written as short, concise sentences.

notes:
USAGE:
{短文|たんぶん} is a compound of ⟦{短|たん}→短〜：03959_tan⟧ (short) + ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (sentence/text). It is used in academic and educational contexts such as language tests, writing practice, and composition classes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短文|たんぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ (write a short sentence)
- {短文|たんぶん}⟦{作成|さくせい}→作成：04186_sakusei⟧ (composing a short passage)
- {短文|たんぶん}⟦{読解|どっかい}→読解：15056_dokkai⟧ (short passage comprehension)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{長文|ちょうぶん}→長文：30549_choubun⟧ is the opposite, meaning a long passage or text.
- ⟦{例文|れいぶん}→例文：19450_reibun⟧ means example sentence.
- ⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧ means composition or essay.
